hidden_assets.generation_method: approximate reading of the BSE curves at 1.58, 1.96, 2.33 eV from the paper's Figure 2; ratios are 10, 2, 0.5 for SL and 13, 1, 1 for TL; tolerance ±20% relative accommodates digitisation uncertainty
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: derived from the paper's reported BSE curves; tolerances prevent a random guess from passing

outputs.description: Phonon frequencies of the Raman-active modes in single-layer (SL) and triple-layer (TL) MoTe₂. Compared to paper-reported values.

Squared modulus of the Raman susceptibility tensor xx-component for selected modes, at independent-particle (IP) and Bethe–Salpeter (BSE) levels. The checker computes intensity ratios and verifies crossover/inversion trends against hidden gold values.

output_contract.notes: The Raman susceptibility scaling factor is arbitrary; the checker uses intensity ratios to cancel common factors. The scissor shift from GW is applied to DFT eigenvalues; re-running full GW for each displaced geometry is not required. The quantum interference analysis (Argand plots) is not part of the scored verification.

steps.scoring: fraction of expected modes within tolerance
